# hierarchical-approval

> TypeScript-first multi-level approval workflow engine for ERP systems. Multi-tenant, audit-ready, fully pluggable.

## What this library does

`hierarchical-approval` solves multi-level approval chains for enterprise applications without requiring BPMN, external orchestrators, or bespoke hand-rolled logic. It handles:

- Sequential and parallel approval chains with configurable modes (any / all / majority)
- Conditional routing: levels activate or skip based on document data at submit time
- Optimistic locking with retry policies to prevent concurrent-approval race conditions
- Built-in idempotency: submitting the same document twice returns the existing instance
- Immutable audit trail with old/new state diff on every mutation
- SLA deadline tracking with automatic `approval:sla_breached` events
- Escalation: automatic and manual escalation with delegation and time-limited proxying
- Override: bypass remaining levels (when `allowOverride: true` in the template)
- Multi-tenancy: every adapter call is scoped by `tenantId`
- ApprovalTestKit + ManualClock for deterministic, zero-I/O test suites

## Installation

```
npm install hierarchical-approval
# peer dep for Postgres only:
npm install pg @types/pg
```

## Supported storage adapters

- `MemoryAdapter` — in-process, ideal for development and tests
- `PostgresAdapter` — production-grade, call `.migrate()` once to set up schema

## Pluggable enterprise adapters

Six adapter interfaces for extending behaviour without modifying library code:

- `INotificationAdapter` — send notifications on every approval event
- `IAuditAdapter` — write audit entries to an external WORM sink (Kafka, S3, CloudTrail)
- `IMetricsAdapter` — Prometheus / Datadog / OpenTelemetry counters and timings
- `ISchedulerAdapter` — replace built-in `setInterval` with BullMQ, Temporal, or EventBridge
- `IAuthorizationPolicy` — per-operation access control (e.g. signing authority caps)
- `IOperationMiddleware` — before / after / onError hooks for tracing, logging, quota enforcement

## Built-in enterprise plug-ins (new in 0.3)

Production-grade implementations of the adapter ports above, each on its own tree-shakeable
import subpath with zero runtime dependencies:

- `hierarchical-approval/plugins/audit` — `HashChainAuditAdapter` (SHA-256 tamper-evident chain with `verify()` detecting edits, deletions, reordering, and tail truncation), `RedactingAuditAdapter` (PII redaction, originals never mutated), `CompositeAuditAdapter` (fault-isolated fan-out)
- `hierarchical-approval/plugins/metrics` — `PrometheusMetricsAdapter` (`scrape()` exposition format), `InMemoryMetricsAdapter` (`snapshot()` with p50/p95), `CompositeMetricsAdapter`
- `hierarchical-approval/plugins/resilience` — `RbacAuthorizationPolicy` (per-operation roles, default-deny), `CompositeAuthorizationPolicy` (AND/OR), `RateLimitMiddleware` (token bucket), `LoggingMiddleware`
- `hierarchical-approval/plugins/notify` — `OutboxNotificationAdapter` (retry + exponential backoff + dead-letter, at-least-once), `TemplatedNotificationAdapter`, `CompositeNotificationAdapter`

## Approver types

- `{ type: 'user', userId: 'alice' }` — specific user ID
- `{ type: 'role', role: 'finance-team' }` — resolved via `orgProvider.getUsersByRole()`
- `{ type: 'dynamic', resolver: 'direct-manager' }` — resolved via registered resolver function
- Custom types via `engine.registerApproverType()`

## Core API

- `engine.defineTemplate(config)` — define a reusable approval chain
- `engine.submit(opts)` — create an approval instance for a document
- `engine.approve(instanceId, opts)` — approve the current level
- `engine.reject(instanceId, opts)` — reject with optional return-to-previous
- `engine.delegate(instanceId, opts)` — delegate approval to another user
- `engine.escalate(instanceId, opts)` — escalate to the configured escalation approver
- `engine.cancel(instanceId, opts)` — cancel an in-flight instance
- `engine.resubmit(instanceId, opts)` — create a new instance linked to a rejected one
- `engine.override(instanceId, opts)` — bypass remaining levels
- `engine.bulkApprove(ids, opts)` — batch approve up to 200 instances

## Events emitted

`approval:submitted`, `approval:approved`, `approval:rejected`, `approval:level_advanced`,
`approval:delegated`, `approval:escalated`, `approval:cancelled`, `approval:expired`,
`approval:overridden`, `approval:resubmitted`, `approval:sla_breached`, `approval:completed`
